nomen.name: Shear From Angles
nomen.info: Create a shearing transformation based on X and Y angles. If an input shape is provided, it will be sheared accordingly.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Shearing base plane. Geometry within this plane does not get transformed.

inputs.name: X Angle
inputs.info: Shearing angle around the plane X-axis.

inputs.name: Y Angle
inputs.info: Shearing angle around the plane Y-axis.

inputs.name: Maintain Height
inputs.info: If true, the shearing magnitude is adjusted to maintain elevations.

nomen.name: Shear From Normal
nomen.info: Creating a shearing transformation towards a custom direction. If an input shape is provided, it will be sheared accordingly.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Shearing base plane. Geometry within this plane does not get transformed.

nomen.name: Classify Transform
nomen.info: Classify a transformation based on its mathematical category.

outputs.name: Identity
outputs.info: True if the transformation equals the identity matrix and does not affect shapes at all.

outputs.name: Translation
outputs.info: True if the transformation contains only translations.

outputs.name: Rotation
outputs.info: True if the transformation contains only rotations.

outputs.name: Rigid
outputs.info: True if the transformation is made up of a combination of translations and rotations.

outputs.name: Similarity
outputs.info: True if the transformation is made up of a combination of translations, rotations, dilations and reflections.

outputs.name: Affine
outputs.info: True if the transformation is affine, meaning it lacks perspective or tapering aspects.

nomen.name: Decompose Affine
nomen.info: Decompose an affine transformation into a linear and a translational aspect.

outputs.name: Translation
outputs.info: Translational aspect of the given transformation.

outputs.name: Linear
outputs.info: Linear aspect of the given transformation.

nomen.name: Decompose Rigid
nomen.info: Decompose a rigid transformation into a translational and a rotational aspect.

outputs.name: Translation
outputs.info: Translational aspect of the given transformation.

outputs.name: Rotation
outputs.info: Rotational aspect of the given transformation.

nomen.name: Decompose Similarity
nomen.info: Decompose a similarity transformation into a translation, a dilation and a rotational aspect.

outputs.name: Translation
outputs.info: Translational aspect of the given transformation.

outputs.name: Dilation
outputs.info: Dilational aspect of the given transformation.

outputs.name: Rotation
outputs.info: Rotational aspect of the given transformation.

nomen.name: Dilation Vector
nomen.info: Extract the dilation vector of a transformation matrix, corrected for rotation.

outputs.name: X Factor
outputs.info: Scaling factor for the X direction.

outputs.name: Y Factor
outputs.info: Scaling factor for the Y direction.

outputs.name: Z Factor
outputs.info: Scaling factor for the Z direction.

nomen.name: Extract Dilation
nomen.info: Extract the dilational aspect of a transformation.

outputs.name: Pivot
outputs.info: Origin point of the embedded dilation.

outputs.name: Factor
outputs.info: Scaling factor of the embedded dilation.

nomen.name: Extract Rotation
nomen.info: Extract the axis and the angle of a rotational transformation.

nomen.name: Extract Translation
nomen.info: Extract the translational aspect of a transformation.

outputs.name: Translation
outputs.info: Translation embedded in the given transformation.

nomen.name: Extract Yaw-Pitch-Roll
nomen.info: Extract the yaw, pitch and roll angles of a transformation.

outputs.name: Yaw
outputs.info: Yaw rotation embedded in the transformation.

outputs.name: Pitch
outputs.info: Pitch rotation embedded in the transformation.

outputs.name: Roll
outputs.info: Roll rotation embedded in the transformation.

nomen.name: Translation Vector
nomen.info: Extract the translation vector of a transformation matrix. Note that rotation and dilation will manifest as a kind of translation too, but are not included in these outputs.

outputs.name: X Motion
outputs.info: Translation motion in the X direction.

outputs.name: Y Motion
outputs.info: Translation motion in the Y direction.

outputs.name: Z Motion
outputs.info: Translation motion in the Z direction.

nomen.name: Classify Quaternion
nomen.info: Classify a quaternion by its properties.

outputs.name: Valid
outputs.info: If true, the quaternion is valid.

outputs.name: Zero
outputs.info: If true, all coefficients equal zero.

outputs.name: Scalar
outputs.info: If true, the scalar coefficient is non-zero, while all vector coefficients equal zero.

outputs.name: Vector
outputs.info: If true, at least one of the vector coefficients is not zero.

outputs.name: Unit
outputs.info: If true, the quaternion has unit length.

nomen.name: Dissect Quaternion
nomen.info: Dissect a quaternion by extracting the A, B, C, and D coefficients.

nomen.name: Invert Quaternion
nomen.info: Invert a quaternion by dividing all vector coefficients by the negative of the length squared.

nomen.name: Quaternion Lerp
nomen.info: Interpolate between two quaternions using linear interpolation.

nomen.name: Quaternion Standard
nomen.info: Create a quaternion standard value.

nomen.name: Quaternion Distance
nomen.info: Compute the norm-distance between two quaternions.

outputs.name: Distance
outputs.info: Norm-distance between the two given quaternions.

nomen.name: Quaternion From Coefficients
nomen.info: Create a quaternion out of A, B, C, and D coefficients.

nomen.name: Quaternion From Orientation
nomen.info: Create the quaternion needed to rotate from a source to a target plane.

outputs.name: Quaternion
outputs.info: Quaternion encoding the rotation from A to B.

nomen.name: Quaternion From Rotation
nomen.info: Convert an axial rotation into an equivalent quaternion.

nomen.name: Rotate Towards
nomen.info: Rotate one quaternion towards another.

nomen.name: Rotation From Quaternion
nomen.info: Convert a quaternion into an equivalent axial rotation.

outputs.name: Axis
outputs.info: Rotation axis, anchored at the world origin.

nomen.name: Quaternion Slerp
nomen.info: Interpolate between two quaternions using spherical-linear interpolation.

nomen.name: Unitise Quaternion
nomen.info: Unitise a quaternion so that $A²+B²+C²+D²$ equals $1$.

nomen.name: Cage From Corners
nomen.info: Create a twisted box cage with straight edges out of eight corner points.

outputs.name: Cage
outputs.info: Twisted box cage with straight edges.

nomen.name: Combine Transformations
nomen.info: Combine multiple transformations into a single one.

nomen.name: Invert Transformation
nomen.info: Create the inverse of a transformation, when possible.

inputs.name: Transformation
inputs.info: Transformation to invert. This transformation must not involve projections onto planes, lines or points.

nomen.name: Repeat Transformation
nomen.info: Fully repeat a transformation a given number of times.

nomen.name: Transform Shape
nomen.info: Transform a shape and its meta data with a given transformation.

nomen.name: Transform Without Rotate
nomen.info: Transform a shape and its meta data with a given transformation, while retaining the original orientation.

nomen.name: Transform Without Scale
nomen.info: Transform a shape and its meta data with a given transformation, while retaining the original size.

nomen.name: Box Mapping
nomen.info: Transform a shape using source and target reference boxes. The specifics of the transformation are encoded by the differences between the boxes. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

outputs.name: Transformation
outputs.info: Transformation consisting of the translation, dilation and rotation required to go from the source to the target box.

nomen.name: Camera Obscura
nomen.info: Invert a shape through the pinhole point of a camera obscura. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.info: Scaling factor for the inverted projection.

nomen.name: Mirror
nomen.info: Create a reflection transformation in a plane. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

nomen.name: Project
nomen.info: Create a projection transformation onto a plane.If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

nomen.name: Project Along
nomen.info: Create a projection transformation onto a plane along a given direction. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Direction
inputs.info: Projection direction. Must not be parallel to the plane.

nomen.name: Rectangle Mapping
nomen.info: Transform a shape using source and target reference rectangles. The specifics of the transformation are encoded by the differences between the rectangles.

outputs.name: Transformation
outputs.info: Transformation consisting of the translation, dilation and rotation required to go from the source to the target rectangle.

nomen.name: Scale 1D
nomen.info: Create a dilation, or scaling transformation, in a single direction. If an input shape is provided, it will be scaled accordingly.

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.info: Scaling factor along the axis, pinned at the axis start point.

nomen.name: Scale 2D
nomen.info: Create two-dimensional dilation, or scaling transformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be scaled accordingly.

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.info: Uniform scaling factor in the origin plane X and Y directions.

nomen.name: Scale 3D
nomen.info: Create a dilation, or scaling transformation, which is equal in all directions. If an input shape is provided, it will be scaled accordingly.

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.info: Uniform scaling factor towards or away from the origin.

nomen.name: Scale Non-uniform
nomen.info: Create a dilation, or scaling transformation, using different factors in the X, Y, and Z directions. If an input shape is provided, it will be scaled accordingly.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Plane specifying the origin and axis directions of the scaling transformation.

inputs.name: Factor X
inputs.info: Scaling factor in plane X direction.

inputs.name: Factor Y
inputs.info: Scaling factor in plane Y direction.

inputs.name: Factor Z
inputs.info: Scaling factor in plane Z direction.

nomen.name: Scale To Area
nomen.info: Resize a shape equally in all directions until its area falls within an allowed range. This component assumes the area of a shape changes with the square of the scaling factor.

nomen.name: Scale To Volume
nomen.info: Resize a shape equally in all directions until its volume falls within an allowed range. This component assumes the volume of a shape changes with the cube of the scaling factor.

nomen.name: Tetrahedron Mapping
nomen.info: Transform a shape using source and target reference tetrahedra. The specifics of the transformation are encoded by the differences between the tetrahedra.

inputs.name: Source
inputs.info: The four vertices of the tetrahedron representing the initial state.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.info: The four vertices of the tetrahedron representing the final state.

outputs.name: Transformation
outputs.info: Transformation consisting of the translation, dilation, rotation and shearing required to go from the source to the target tetrahedron.

nomen.name: Triangle Mapping
nomen.info: Transform a shape using source and target reference triangles. The specifics of the transformation are encoded by the differences between the triangles.

outputs.name: Transformation
outputs.info: Transformation consisting of the translation, dilation, rotation and shearing required to go from the source to the target triangle.

nomen.name: Array Linear
nomen.info: Create a linear array of translations. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Motion
inputs.info: Motion vector describing the spacing between adjacent array elements.

outputs.name: Transformations
outputs.info: List of translations applied to each element in the array.

nomen.name: Array Rectangular
nomen.info: Create a rectangular array of translations. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Cell
inputs.info: Grid cell describing the spacing between adjacent array elements.

inputs.name: Range X
inputs.info: Number of array elements in the cell X direction.

inputs.name: Range Y
inputs.info: Number of array elements in the cell Y direction.

outputs.name: Transformations
outputs.info: List of translations applied to each element in the array.

nomen.name: Array Boxular
nomen.info: Create a volumetric, orthogonal array of translations. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Cell
inputs.info: Grid cell describing the spacing between adjacent array elements.

inputs.name: Range X
inputs.info: Number of array elements in the cell X direction.

inputs.name: Range Y
inputs.info: Number of array elements in the cell Y direction.

inputs.name: Range Z
inputs.info: Number of array elements in the cell Z direction.

outputs.name: Transformations
outputs.info: List of translations applied to each element in the array.

nomen.name: Array Along Curve
nomen.info: Create an array of transformations along a rail curve. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Count
inputs.info: Number of transformed elements along the curve.

inputs.name: Orientation
inputs.info: Orientation constraint for the arrayed shapes.

outputs.name: Transformations
outputs.info: List of transformations applied to each element in the array.

nomen.name: Array Arcular
nomen.info: Create an arc shaped array of rotations spanning a sweep angle. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Centre and orientation of the array.

inputs.name: Angle
inputs.info: Sweep angle of the array, measured counter-clockwise from the plane x-axis.

inputs.name: Count
inputs.info: Number of elements in the array.

inputs.name: Extent
inputs.info: Rule for how the sweep is filled with elements.

outputs.name: Transformations
outputs.info: List of rotations applied to each element in the array.

nomen.name: Array Circular
nomen.info: Create a circular array of rotations. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Centre and orientation of circular array.

inputs.name: Count
inputs.info: Number of elements in the array.

outputs.name: Transformations
outputs.info: List of rotations applied to each element in the array.

nomen.name: Array From Gaps
nomen.info: Create a sequence of shapes along a curve with a specific gap size. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

nomen.name: Array Polar
nomen.info: Create a polar array of rotations. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Centre and orientation of polar array.

inputs.name: Elevation
inputs.info: Optional function giving the elevation of each array element. The function must be scaled to element index, rather than element angle.

outputs.name: Transformations
outputs.info: List of transformations applied to each element in the array.

nomen.name: Move
nomen.info: Create a translation transformation along a vector. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

nomen.name: Move Onto Plane
nomen.info: Move a shape in a direction perpendicular to a plane, until the plane and shape come into contact.

inputs.name: Above
inputs.info: If true, move objects above the plane.

inputs.name: Below
inputs.info: If true, move objects below the plane.

nomen.name: Move Polar
nomen.info: Create a translation transformation using polar coordinates. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

nomen.name: Move With Field
nomen.info: Move a shape using the flow of a vector field, as measured at the centre of the shape bounding box.

inputs.name: Field
inputs.info: Field exerting a force on the shape.

inputs.name: Strength
inputs.info: Motion strength. Single Step scales the field vector by it, Integrate reads it as the duration of the flow, and Trajectory reads it as the length of the trajectory. Negative values move the shape upstream.

nomen.name: Move With Field
nomen.info: Move a shape using the direction and magnitude of a vector field, as measured at the centre of the shape bounding box.

inputs.name: Field
inputs.info: Field exerting a force on the shape.

nomen.name: Orient
nomen.info: Create an orientation transformation from one plane to another. An orientation consists of translational and rotational aspects. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

nomen.name: Orient 2D
nomen.info: Create an orientation transformation from one axis to another. A two-dimensional orientation consists of translational, rotational, and dilational aspects. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

nomen.name: Orient Direction
nomen.info: Create an orientation transformation from one direction to another in 3D space.

nomen.name: Rotate About Axis
nomen.info: Create a rotation around an origin point and an axis direction. If an input shape is provided, it will be rotated accordingly.

inputs.name: Angle
inputs.info: Rotational angle. Positive angles cause a counter-clockwise rotation.

nomen.name: Rotate Direction
nomen.info: Create a rotation from one direction to another. If an input shape is provided, it will be rotated accordingly.

nomen.name: Rotate Euler Angles
nomen.info: Create a rotation through Euler angles.

inputs.name: Alpha
inputs.info: First rotation about the world Z axis.

inputs.name: Beta
inputs.info: Second rotation about the world Y axis.

inputs.name: Gamma
inputs.info: Third rotation about the world Z axis again.

nomen.name: Rotate In Plane
nomen.info: Create a rotation around the origin and the normal axis of a plane. If an input shape is provided, it will be rotated accordingly.

inputs.name: Angle
inputs.info: Rotational angle. Positive angles cause a counter-clockwise rotation.

nomen.name: Yaw Pitch Roll
nomen.info: Create a rotation through Tait-Bryan angles, commonly known as Yaw, Pitch, and Roll.

inputs.name: Yaw
inputs.info: Yaw rotation about the world Z axis.

inputs.name: Pitch
inputs.info: Pitch rotation about the world Y axis.

inputs.name: Roll
inputs.info: Roll rotation about the world X axis.

nomen.name: Apply Deform
nomen.info: Apply a non-linear spatial deformation to a shape.

inputs.name: Preserve
inputs.info: If true, the underlying control-point structure is preserved during deformation.

nomen.name: Bend Deform
nomen.info: Create a bending deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Bending Arc
inputs.info: Arc defining the start, length, and angles of the bending portion of the deformation.

nomen.name: Cage Between Edges
nomen.info: Create a twisted box cage between four edges.

inputs.name: Front Left Edge
inputs.info: Edge in cage W direction at $(u,v)$ = (0,0).

inputs.name: Front Right Edge
inputs.info: Edge in cage W direction at $(u,v)$ = (1,0)

inputs.name: Back Left Edge
inputs.info: Edge in cage W direction at $(u,v)$ = (0,1)

inputs.name: Back Right Edge
inputs.info: Edge in cage W direction at $(u,v)$ = (1,1)

inputs.name: Degree U
inputs.info: Degree in cage U direction, between 1 and 7.

inputs.name: Degree V
inputs.info: Degree in cage V direction, between 1 and 7.

inputs.name: Degree W
inputs.info: Degree in cage W direction, between 1 and 7.

nomen.name: Cage Between Faces
nomen.info: Create a twisted box cage between two surfaces.

inputs.name: Bottom
inputs.info: Surface for bottom face of cage.

inputs.name: Top
inputs.info: Surface for top face of cage.

inputs.name: Degree U
inputs.info: Degree in cage U direction, between 1 and 7.

inputs.name: Degree V
inputs.info: Degree in cage V direction, between 1 and 7.

inputs.name: Degree W
inputs.info: Degree in cage W direction, between 1 and 7.

nomen.name: Cage Deform
nomen.info: Create a cage deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Source
inputs.info: Simple box representing the initial form.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.info: Twisted cage representing the final form.

nomen.name: Cage From Surface
nomen.info: Create a deformation cage on a single-face surface.

inputs.name: U Interval
inputs.info: U interval for the subsurface to create the cage on.

inputs.name: V Interval
inputs.info: V interval for the subsurface to create the cage on.

inputs.name: Degree U
inputs.info: Degree in cage U direction, between 1 and 7.

inputs.name: Degree V
inputs.info: Degree in cage V direction, between 1 and 7.

inputs.name: Degree W
inputs.info: Degree in cage W direction, between 1 and 7.

nomen.name: Change Of Basis
nomen.info: Create a transformation from one oblique coordinate system into another.

inputs.name: Source Origin
inputs.info: Point of origin of the source coordinate system.

inputs.name: Source X
inputs.info: X unit vector of the source coordinate system.

inputs.name: Source Y
inputs.info: Y unit vector of the source coordinate system.

inputs.name: Source Z
inputs.info: Z unit vector of the source coordinate system.

inputs.name: Target Origin
inputs.info: Point of origin of the target coordinate system.

inputs.name: Target X
inputs.info: X unit vector of the target coordinate system.

inputs.name: Target Y
inputs.info: Y unit vector of the target coordinate system.

inputs.name: Target Z
inputs.info: Z unit vector of the target coordinate system.

nomen.name: Combine Deform
nomen.info: Combine two non-linear spatial deformations.

nomen.name: Curl Deform
nomen.info: Create a curling deformation. Curling is similar to wringing, but with a curved axis. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Angle
inputs.info: Either a global angle, or a function which defines a unique angle for every parameter along the axis curve.

inputs.name: Degrees
inputs.info: If true, function values are interpreted to represent angular degrees. If false, it is assumed to be in radians.

nomen.name: Mirror In Curve
nomen.info: Create a curve mirror deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Shape
inputs.info: Optional shape to mirror in the curve.

inputs.name: Infinite
inputs.info: If true, open mirror curves are extended linearly at both ends.

nomen.name: Evaluate Cage
nomen.info: Evaluate a cage at normalised (u,v,w) parameters.

inputs.name: U Parameter
inputs.info: Normalised parameter in the cage U direction.

inputs.name: V Parameter
inputs.info: Normalised parameter in the cage V direction.

inputs.name: W Parameter
inputs.info: Normalised parameter in the cage W direction.

nomen.name: Expand Deform
nomen.info: Create an expansion deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Seed
inputs.info: Seed from which expansion is measured. May be a point, a plane, an infinite line, or a curve.

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.info: Function encoding the scaling factor based on the distance to the seed. Ideally this function is strictly increasing.

nomen.name: Field Deform
nomen.info: Create a vector field deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Motion
inputs.info: Optional magnitude of particle motion through the field.

nomen.name: Flow Along Curve
nomen.info: Create a deformation from one axial curve to another. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Source
inputs.info: Optional source curve. If omitted, a line tangent with the start of the target curve is used.

inputs.name: R Factor
inputs.info: Scaling factor radial to the target curve.

nomen.name: Flow Along Surface
nomen.info: Create a flow deformation which maps onto a surface UVW space. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Source
inputs.info: Source space in the form of a rectilinear box.

inputs.name: U Domain
inputs.info: Optional U domain for target space. If omitted, the entire domain will be used.

inputs.name: V Domain
inputs.info: Optional V domain for target space. If omitted, the entire domain will be used.

inputs.name: W Factor
inputs.info: Scaling factor in the surface normal direction.

nomen.name: Maelstrom Deform
nomen.info: Create a spiral deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

nomen.name: Offset Deform
nomen.info: Create an offset deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Seed
inputs.info: Seed from which the offset is measured. May be a point, a plane, an infinite line, or a curve.

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.info: Function encoding the offset amount based on the distance to the seed. Ideally the function intersects $(0,0)$.

nomen.name: Splop Deform
nomen.info: Create a splop deformation which maps from flat space into surface UVW space. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Locus
inputs.info: Surface locus where the deformation origin is anchored.

nomen.name: Sporph Deform
nomen.info: Create a sporph deformation which maps between surface UVW spaces. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Source
inputs.info: Reference source surface for sporph deformation.

nomen.name: Stretch Deform
nomen.info: Create a stretching deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Line
inputs.info: Line covering the region to be stretched.

inputs.name: Length
inputs.info: Length of stretched line, as measured from the fixed start.

nomen.name: Mirror In Surface
nomen.info: Create a surface mirror deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Shape
inputs.info: Optional shape to mirror in the surface.

inputs.name: Infinite
inputs.info: If true, the reflection occurs in the tangent plane at the closest point on the surface.

nomen.name: Taper Deform
nomen.info: Create a tapering deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Start Radius
inputs.info: Radius at the start of the taper axis.

inputs.name: End Radius
inputs.info: Radius at the end of the taper axis.

inputs.name: Infinite
inputs.info: If true, the taper deformation extends infinitely beyond the limits of the axis.

nomen.name: Twist Deform
nomen.info: Create a twisting deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Angle 1
inputs.info: Rotational angle at the start of the axis.

inputs.name: Angle 2
inputs.info: Rotational angle at the end of the axis.

inputs.name: Profile
inputs.info: Progression of the twist along the axis.

nomen.name: Twist Deform
nomen.info: Create a twisting deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Angle 1
inputs.info: Rotational angle at the start of the axis.

inputs.name: Angle 2
inputs.info: Rotational angle at the end of the axis.

nomen.name: Wring Deform
nomen.info: Create a wringing deformation. Wringing is similar to twisting, but with a variable angle progression. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Orientation plane. The wringing axis is coincident with the plane z-axis.

inputs.name: Angle
inputs.info: Function describing the wringing angle based on distance to plane.

inputs.name: Degrees
inputs.info: If true, the function values represent angles measured in degrees instead of radians.
